'''Yasu no Kuni no Miyatsuko''' (''yasu no kuni no miyatsuko'', ''yasu kokuzō'') was a {{ill|kuni no miyatsuko|ja|国造}} who ruled the eastern part of {{ill|Ōmi Province|ja|近江国}} (the eastern shore of {{ill|Lake Biwa|ja|琵琶湖}}). Also known as '''Ōmi-Yasu no Kuni no Miyatsuko''' and '''Chika-tsu-Ōmi-Yasu no Kuni no Miyatsuko'''.

== Overview ==
=== Ancestry ===
*According to the ''{{ill|Kojiki|ja|古事記}}'', the ancestor was {{ill|Mizu-no-Homawaka-no-Mikoto|ja|水之穂真若王}}, son of {{ill|Hikoimasu-no-Ōkimi|ja|日子坐王}}, and is considered of the same line as the {{ill|Ōmi no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja|淡海国造}}.

=== Clan ===
'''{{ill|Yasu clan|ja|安氏}}''' (''yasu-uji''; {{ill|kabane|ja|カバネ|lt=kabane|lt_ja=姓}} of {{ill|Atai (kabane)|ja|直 (姓)|lt=Atai|lt_ja=直}}).

=== Base ===
{{ill|Yasu District, Ōmi|ja|野洲郡|lt=Yasu District}} in {{ill|Ōmi Province|ja|近江国}} — corresponding to present-day {{ill|Yasu, Shiga|ja|野洲市}} and {{ill|Moriyama, Shiga|ja|守山市}} in {{ill|Shiga Prefecture|ja|滋賀県}}. Later it is said to have been placed under the rule of the {{ill|Ōmi no Kuni no Miyatsuko|ja|淡海国造}}{{Citation needed|date=March 2022}}.

=== Tutelary deity ===
Unknown; possibly {{ill|Ame-no-Mikage-no-Kami|ja|天之御影神}}.<ref>{{ill|Kawaguchi Kenji|ja|川口謙二}}, ''Tōkyō Bijutsu Sensho 23 Zoku Kami-gami no Keizu'' ({{ill|Tōkyō Bijutsu|ja|東京美術}}, 1980), p.66.</ref>

=== People ===
*{{ill|Ōtamusaka-no-Ōkimi|ja|大多牟坂王}} (''ōtamusaka-no-miko''; also written Ōtamuyawake / Otamuwake)
*:First Ōmi-Yasu no Kuni no Miyatsuko. A third-generation descendant of {{ill|Hikoimasu-no-Ōkimi|ja|彦坐王}}, or a descendant of {{ill|Amatsuhikone-no-Mikoto|ja|天津彦根命}}.
*{{ill|Futaji-hime|ja|布多遅比売}} (''futaji-hime'', also Futamichiirihime-no-Mikoto)
*:Daughter of Ōtamusaka-no-Ōkimi. Married {{ill|Yamato Takeru|ja|倭建命}} and bore {{ill|Inayoriwake-no-Ōkimi|ja|稲依別王}}.
*Sakata-no-Tarine-no-Kimi (''sakata no tarine no kimi'')
*:Son of Ōtamusaka-no-Ōkimi.
